ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Read from the problem statement: the solution set of the inequality ax-b<0 is (1,+∞). In a linear inequality, if a>0, then ax-b<0 is equivalent to x<b/a; if a<0, then ax-b<0 is equivalent to x>b/a. Now the direction of the solution set is x>1, so it must have a<0, and b/a=1, therefore b=a. Thus ax+b=ax+a=a(x+1). The inequality to be found, (ax+b)(x-3)>0, can be transformed into a(x+1)(x-3)>0. Because a<0, when dividing both sides by the negative number a, the inequality sign reverses, obtaining (x+1)(x-3)<0. The zeros of this quadratic product are -1 and 3, and the product being less than 0 holds between the two roots, so the solution set is (-1,3).

method.method_draft: 从题面读出：一次不等式 ax-b<0 的解集为 (1,+∞)。利用一次不等式通解规则：若 a<0，则 ax-b<0 等价于 x>b/a；若 a>0，则等价于 x<b/a。因为给出的方向是 x>1，所以必须有 a<0 且 b/a=1，即 b=a。于是 ax+b=ax+a=a(x+1)。待求不等式变为 a(x+1)(x-3)>0。由于 a<0，两边除以负数时不等号反向，得到 (x+1)(x-3)<0。再用二次因式符号法，两个零点为 -1 和 3，乘积小于 0 在两根之间，所以解集为 (-1,3)。
